task: P5.4 (partial: HF heuristic + HF confidence-threshold(static) baselines done; BanditSpec cloned+inspected, unrunnable locally -> cloud stage)
api_note: transformers 5.16.1: assisted-gen params (num_assistant_tokens, num_assistant_tokens_schedule, assistant_confidence_threshold) are read from draft.generation_config, NOT from target.generate() kwargs -- passing them to generate() is silently ignored.
confidence_threshold_note: scikit-learn absent -> assistant_confidence_threshold used STATICALLY at 0.4 (ConfidenceCriteria early-stop); the online ROC-curve retuning (Intel/HF Dynamic Speculation Lookahead) is gated on is_sklearn_available() and did NOT run. Installing scikit-learn would enable it.
primary_metric: tokens produced per target forward pass (hardware-independent)
primary_metric_caveat: pitfall 14: this metric has no draft-cost term, so a schedule that uses larger assistant windows (HF 'heuristic', up to 10-15 here) scores higher by spending more draft forwards per round -- the trade the metric omits. Rank by tokens-per-target-forward is NOT a rank by tokens-per-compute-unit.
wall_clock_caveat: HF assisted generation uses a KV cache; our speculative_generate / gammatune_generate do not. Wall-clock is not comparable.
alpha_note: ours = EXACT. HF = ESTIMATED from wrapped-forward counts. Dev sanity check with fully-aligned sampling: HF constant-g3 2.89 tok/tf / alpha 0.77 vs ours 2.93 / 0.80 -- agree, so our rejection sampler matches HF's.

per_config.alpha_is: EXACT: from accept_lengths / evaluated (derived from gamma_trace)

conclusion:
hf_constant_g3           tok/target-fwd 2.773 +/- 0.171   alpha~0.771
hf_constant_g5           tok/target-fwd 3.041 +/- 0.145   alpha~0.716
hf_heuristic             tok/target-fwd 4.957 +/- 0.797   alpha~0.690
hf_confidence_0.4_static tok/target-fwd 3.782 +/- 0.172   alpha~0.708
ours_fixed_gamma_1       tok/target-fwd 1.768 +/- 0.006   alpha~0.773
ours_fixed_gamma_3       tok/target-fwd 2.852 +/- 0.057   alpha~0.781
ours_fixed_gamma_5       tok/target-fwd 3.550 +/- 0.038   alpha~0.790
ours_gammatune           tok/target-fwd 3.187 +/- 0.087   alpha~0.773

Ours best = ours_fixed_gamma_5 at 3.550 tok/target-fwd. HF heuristic = 4.957. HF confidence(0.4, static) = 3.782. Not a superiority claim -- honest numbers on a hardware-independent axis. HF alpha is ESTIMATED from forward counts; close agreement with our EXACT alpha on the same pair (validated during dev at ~0.77 vs ~0.80) means the hand-written rejection sampler matches HF's. scikit-learn is absent so the confidence threshold is STATIC 0.4, not the online-retuned DSL form.

CAVEAT (pitfall 14): tokens-per-target-forward has NO draft-cost term. HF 'heuristic' tops this metric by ratcheting the assistant window up to 10-15 on easy prompts (hence its large std) -- it buys the lead with many more draft forwards per round, exactly the cost this metric ignores. A cost-model comparison (c + window per round) would need HF's per-round window sizes, which this run does not capture. Our GammaTune (mean gamma ~3.7) deliberately does not chase this metric; it sits mid-pack, consistent with P5.0.

banditspec_baseline.repo: github.com/sail-sg/BanditSpec (depth-1 clone to /tmp, inspected, deleted; not committed to this repo per plan sec 3 non-goal 3)
blockers: qwen.py line 56 does a hard top-level import of flash_attn_func / flash_attn_with_kvcache from flash_attn; flash-attn is CUDA-only, no Apple Silicon / MPS build, so the module cannot even be imported here.
inference_length.py is hard-wired to CUDA: .cuda() on every tensor, device_map="auto", bf16; generate_utils.py times with torch.cuda.synchronize() throughout.
Requires EAGLE trained draft heads (eagle_qwen.py / separate model download) -- a different architecture from this project's independent-draft-model setup (draft = full Qwen2.5-0.5B).
banditspec_baseline.why_not_worked_around: Running it unmodified is the point of using it as a baseline (plan sec 3 non-goal 3 / pitfall 12: compare against their code, do not reimplement). Making it run on MPS needs replacing the custom flash-attn Qwen attention, stripping all CUDA calls, and supplying/training an EAGLE head -- at which point it is no longer their code.
banditspec_baseline.disposition: Belongs on the cloud GPU stage (M7/M8) where CUDA + flash-attn + EAGLE models are available. Recorded here as a known-unrun baseline; not a failure (task 2b is explicitly optional).
